newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo bourse seeks to list Maspro Denkoh.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo bourse seeks to list Maspro Denkoh.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Thursday that it applied to the Finance Ministry for approval to list shares of Maspro Denkoh Corp.

Maspro Denkoh, a manufacturer of electronics and communications equipment, is expected to be listed on March 13, the TSE said. The company is currently listed on the second section of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
The company will offer 300,000 shares through a secondary offering when it is listed in Tokyo, the TSE said.
